# Rebecca 1.9.2

Rebecca 1.9.2 changes how the master delivers config and user changes to nodes, so inbound, host and service edits reach nodes within seconds and a node that falls behind can no longer stall the others. It also includes the redesigned login screen. It has no database changes.

## Node sync

- Every node now has its own sync worker. A slow or unreachable node only delays itself, and a node is never processed twice at once.
- Config changes (inbounds, hosts, services, node config) are pushed right after the request that made them instead of waiting for the next polling round.
- A node that keeps failing cools down for 1 second up to 5 minutes instead of being resynced every few seconds.
- When a node has more than 50 open user changes, or a user change that already failed 3 times, the whole backlog is replaced by one full sync built from the database.
- User changes queued for nodes that are not connected are dropped. Connecting, restarting, updating or recovering a node always runs a full sync.
- A node that comes back after a failure, or reports that Xray is not started, gets a full sync.
- Finished queue rows are deleted at once, and duplicate or stale syncs of inactive and deleted nodes are cleaned up.
- Queue maintenance and bulk completion retry MySQL deadlocks instead of failing.

## Dashboard

- Redesigned authentication flow with the new login shell, localized messages and an accessible one-time code field.
- Dashboard tables remember the columns you choose across page refreshes.

## Upgrade notes

> This release changes no database schema. The database stays at schema version 68 and no migration runs. Install Rebecca Node 1.8.0 with this release.
>
> Existing nodes keep working. After updating the master, nodes that already had a long backlog receive one full sync, which restarts Xray on that node for a few seconds.
